projects.name: Legacy Orbital Port: Fortran to Rust and C++20

Both optimized and checked profiles passed locally and in CI. Clean checkout passed. Published ZIP checksum matches.

projects.name: ADK-style Python Runtime Optimization Lab
projects.implementation_note: Treat as a standalone educational runtime, not an upstream google/adk-python optimization. Audit nested input/output mutation semantics and tool changes before caching or removing copies. Supplied artificial sleeps and hardcoded percent targets do not establish real performance. Measure fresh-process imports and repeated latency/memory with honest workload and provenance.

projects.name: Android 2D-to-3D Spatial UI and Compiler Repair
projects.implementation_note: Requires an actual Android project and successful assembleDebug. A simulated diagnostic loop is not an APK build. Use constrained paths and real diagnostic locations when applying patches.

projects.name: Desk Racer
projects.implementation_note: Supplied scene uses example detections, not a reconstruction of the user's actual desk. Label synthetic fixtures. Validate full traversable track segments, obstacle collision envelopes, and units, not only checkpoint centers.

projects.name: Parametric Pagoda and Independent Critic
projects.implementation_note: The brief explicitly requests a separate critic subagent for this phase. Require actual Blender output/render/export and independent geometry/visual evidence. Do not promote metadata-only fallback or hardcoded visual scores to a verified render/export.
Actual WGSL compute/render fur-strand simulation plus cable mode, CPU reference, race-free buffers, measurable constraint/parity/stability gates and explicit fallback/device-loss handling.
Synthetic DEXA text extraction, disjoint-region mass checks with correct quantities/units and missing-data rules; own schematic three-dimensional region inspector, heatmaps and no diagnostic claims.
